expectations.text: 响应中明确指出 Harness Engineering 不是“无论什么请求都把 Layer 0 到 Layer 6 全讲一遍”的静态清单
expectations.evidence: The first line says `Harness Engineering 不是一套固定流程，是一套分诊逻辑`.

expectations.text: 响应中提及应先判定 `bootstrap` / `maintenance`，再决定最小起始层或重入层
expectations.evidence: It explicitly says to classify maintenance vs bootstrap/new-feature first and then choose the minimum valid entry layer.

expectations.text: 响应中明确说明新 feature 不能跳过能力边界检查或单组件 MVP 验证直接写 PRD
expectations.evidence: The answer says new feature or bootstrap work `绝不能跳过能力边界检查和单组件 MVP 验证` before blueprinting.

expectations.text: 响应中明确说明维护期问题不需要每次完整回放 Layer 0->6
expectations.evidence: It says a localized maintenance change `根本不需要从 Layer 0 开始复述` and should enter near the changed scope.

expectations.text: 响应中把这套方法讲成推进关系、delivery arc 或等价的方法论，而不是只枚举层号
expectations.evidence: The closing explanation frames the method as a delivery arc with `能力证明 / 工程循环 / 产品化` rather than a static list.

eval_feedback.overall: All expectations passed. The answer gives a concise training speech that reframes HE as triage and movement, not ritual recitation.
